sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Healthcare dominate broad-market leadership as the only all-green sectors, while Consumer Defensive shows early signs of fading.

Energy remains the standout leader across the market, holding the top rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons with an elite momentum score of 0.917 (or 0.92). Healthcare is joining it at the top, gaining ground to reach rank 3 with a 0.850 momentum score. Together, these are the only 2 of 11 sectors exhibiting all-green breadth across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD timeframes.

Rotation remains tight elsewhere. Consumer Cyclical posted a modest 5-session improvement (+1 spot to rank 10), but remains trapped near the bottom alongside Utilities (momentum 0.300) and Communication Services, which sits dead last at rank 11 with a 0.000 momentum score. Meanwhile, Consumer Defensive is actively losing altitude, slipping down the ranks despite an otherwise respectable momentum reading.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 groups (Energy and Healthcare) are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.
- **Persistent leadership:** Energy is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, maintaining a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows with a 0.917 (0.92) momentum score and rank 1 YTD standing.
- **Top-tier momentum:** Energy (0.917), Healthcare (0.850), and Technology (0.750, rank 2 YTD) lead the broader market in overall momentum scores.

## Movers & Momentum
- **5-session gainers:** Consumer Cyclical improved +1 spot (rank 10, momentum 0.317/0.32) and Healthcare advanced +1 spot (rank 3, momentum 0.850/0.85).
- **5-session decliners:** Consumer Defensive slipped -1 spot to rank 4 (momentum 0.600), while Communication Services fell -1 spot to rank 11 (momentum 0.000).
- **Lagging baseline:** Communication Services (0.000), Utilities (0.300), Consumer Cyclical (0.317), and Real Estate (0.367, rank 8 YTD) represent the absolute bottom tier of momentum.

## Divergences
- **Fading momentum in Consumer Defensive:** Consumer Defensive exhibits an early-warning breakdown, slipping 1 rank spot over the last 5 days despite holding a relatively strong momentum score of 0.600.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and defensive staples dominate sustained leadership, while short-term capital is rotating into industrials and out of regulated utilities, tech content, and beverages.

Broad market strength remains narrow, with 23 of 144 industry groups displaying all-green profiles across all standard time horizons. Energy is the most dominant sector at the top, supported by high momentum in Oil & Gas Drilling (0.861), Oil & Gas E&P (0.858), and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.848). Sustained multi-month outperformance also persists in pockets of healthcare and staples, led by Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.83) and Tobacco (momentum 0.81).

Shorter-term 5-day rotations show an aggressive bid into industrials and services, with Engineering & Construction climbing 30 spots and Electronic Components gaining 26 spots. Conversely, defensive yields and consumer discretionary pockets are losing ground rapidly: Utilities - Regulated Water plunged 33 spots, while Internet Content & Information dropped 26 spots to rank 115, joining structural laggards like Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.050) near the bottom.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 23 of 144 groups maintain positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half, and year-to-date, led by REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.880, rank 8 YTD) and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.866, rank 24 YTD).
- **Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas Drilling (0.861 momentum), Oil & Gas E&P (0.858 momentum), and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.848 momentum) remain clustered in the top 10 YTD rankings.
- **Sustained Multi-Month Leaders:** Top-36 consistency across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons is concentrated in Oil & Gas Integrated, Drug Manufacturers - General, Tobacco, Medical Care Facilities, Medical Distribution, Business Equipment & Supplies, Credit Services, and Household & Personal Products.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Gainers:** Engineering & Construction moved up 30 spots to rank 50 (momentum 0.40), Electronic Components jumped 26 spots to rank 30 (momentum 0.53), and Security & Protection Services rose 22 spots to rank 41 (momentum 0.79).
- **Steepest 5-Day Declines:** Utilities - Regulated Water fell 33 spots to rank 73 (momentum 0.38), followed by Internet Content & Information falling 26 spots to rank 115 (momentum 0.117) and Beverages - Brewers dropping 24 spots to rank 42 (momentum 0.45).
- **Momentum Troughs:** Advertising Agencies (0.050 momentum, rank 144 YTD), Solar (0.122 momentum, rank 141 YTD), and Gambling (0.125 momentum, rank 143 YTD) anchor the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Engineering & Construction (+30 spots, 0.40 momentum), Specialty Industrial Machinery (+19 spots, 0.50 momentum), and Restaurants (+14 spots, 0.49 momentum) reflect sharp rank jumps ahead of baseline momentum.
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Despite historically high momentum, 5-day ranks are sliding in Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.69, -9 spots), Department Stores (momentum 0.66, -11 spots), Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.62, -12 spots), and Household & Personal Products (momentum 0.60, -10 spots).
- **Fragile Leadership:** Software - Infrastructure maintains an all-green profile across timeframes but carries a fragile rank agreement score of 0.37, signaling underlying positional instability.
